title: Payment of fees brokers of Exchanges
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Payment of fees brokers of Exchanges Dec 10, 1992| Circulars December 10, 1992 To, The President/Executive Director of All the Stock Exchanges. Dear Sirs, Payment of fees brokers of Exchanges Please refer to our earlier correspondence on the above subject. It has been decided to extend the last date of payment of fees by the stock brokers to December 21, 1992. It is requested that the fees already collected from members should be forwarded to SEBI forthwith. The remaining fees may be collected before the 21st December, 1992 and remitted to us immediately on receipt. Yours faithfully, sd/- C. B. Bhave HOD (SMD-II)
